list: Official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (cross-checked 2026-11-18), 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry. Where a step follows only from the official description, the guide says so. Counts (for example 42 Shooting Range challenges, 397 stunts, 18 meditation spots) are the counts PlayStation tracks, as the trophy lists report them.

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here — it is the finish line of the whole roadmap. From the official description, it is simply the reward for becoming a Leonida Legend by doing everything else. Expect a long haul: the guides that have sized the list put the Platinum at roughly 200 to 300 hours, because the Gold for 100% completion sits underneath it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the one possibly-missable meditation trophy, then collectibles, then cleanup — and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, this is the opening mission: finish Gone Fishing and the trophy is yours. It is the first story beat, so just play the campaign from the start and it unlocks naturally. There is no mission replay in GTA VI, according to the launch guides, but an opening mission cannot be skipped, so this one is safe — keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway as a habit for the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks at the chapter's end. While you are in Chapter 1, do the one thing that matters for the whole Platinum: meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, which the launch guides flag as the only trophy that may be missable. Otherwise just enjoy the story — chapter trophies come from playing, not grinding.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete Chapter 2. This is the chapter where, the launch guides note, both Jason and Lucia become playable, so most of the open-world trophy list opens up from here. Use the chapter to start chipping at the long counters — stunts, vehicles discovered, shops — rather than leaving all of them for after the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start to unlock in Chapters 3 and 4, according to the launch guides, so from here on, take the robbery chances the story hands you — bank vaults, armored trucks and illegal operations all count toward their own trophies. Keep a manual save at the chapter start; there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete Chapter 4 — the last chapter before the finale. By now the map, the robbery systems and the side characters should all be open to you. Before you push into the final mission, sweep up anything chapter-bound: meditation spots, stranger strands you have started, and any activity you have not tried yet for Master of None.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the final mission — this is one of only two Gold trophies on the list. Make a manual save right before the finale: the launch guides report there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a pre-finale save is your only way back if you want to re-run anything. After the credits, Push Square notes you can keep exploring Leonida freely, and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks — the cleanup phase starts here.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one unlock by playing the mission through to its end — there is no extra objective hidden in the description. Because there is no mission replay, do not rush past the mission's set-pieces; if a trophy tied to a mission moment worries you, your manual chapter save is the safety net.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this unlocks by finishing the mission itself. Treat it as a warm-up for the free-roam robbery trophies: after the story, bank vaults and armored trucks use the same robbery habits, so pay attention to how the heist handles getaway and escape.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, this one is earned by playing the mission to completion — no side objective is named. It sits in the story chain, so it cannot be done early and cannot be skipped; just keep moving through the chapters.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the story mission Headliners. This is another mission-completion trophy on the story path. The name hints at a big set-piece, but the requirement is only the completion itself — finish Headliners and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport matters twice: this mission trophy, and later the free-roam Catch Me If You Can trophy for an unscheduled departure from the same airport. Finish the mission here, then remember the airport when you are in cleanup.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies — finish the operation and it unlocks. With the mission trophies done, the story chain is nearly complete; the remaining story trophies are the chapter trophies, the finale Gold, and the side-character finales.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: The second Gold and the hardest trophy on the list by most guides' reckoning. From the official description, attain 100% completion. Push Square explains the practical side: a 100% Completion Checklist unlocks when you finish the story, and you can check it in game at any time via Touch Pad, then Progress. The thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx, cited by the trophy lists, puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — and for example only 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count toward it. Do not chase this during the story; finish the campaign, open the checklist, and work it line by line. Almost every other trophy feeds into it, so it is usually one of the last two you earn.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete 250 stunts. Push Square reports there are 397 stunts in total across Leonida, so you need a little over half of them — this is a long grind, not a skill wall. The practical approach is to treat stunts as background noise: jump, drift and air-time your way through normal travel, and use the in-game Progress screen to see your count. Save a dedicated stunt session for the end, when you can chain the easy ones you already know. It is Silver for a reason: the count, not the difficulty.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: From the official description, try each type of activity once — the lists count 9 activity types. This is a sampler, not a grind: one fishing trip, one race, one arcade game, one bowling game, one drone race, one shooting-range challenge, one meditation, one hunt and one round of whatever else the Activities menu offers, and it pops. Do it early in Chapter 2, when the activities open up, because trying them all also teaches you which of the longer trophies (Shooting Range golds, drone race wins) you want to practice first.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: From the official description, earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Push Square confirms the count and notes there are two shooting range locations in Leonida, so the 42 challenges are split between them. This is the skill trophy of the set: learn each challenge's scoring, use the range's own weapons, and gold them one at a time rather than rushing. Check your Progress screen to see which challenges are still short of gold, and leave the hardest for a focused session after the story, when you can retry freely.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: From the official description, win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — the lists count 14 locations. Drone racing is one of the 9 activity types, so a single win also feeds Master of None. Learn one location's course at a time: win it, move on, and use the Progress screen to spot the locations you have not won yet. It pairs well with the race trophy Earn Cash, Not Kudos, since both reward winning races rather than just entering them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, win 20 different races — different is the key word, so repeating the same easy race twenty times will not count. Mix race types and locations: street races, drone races (which also feed Top Fun), and any other race the Activities menu offers. Keep a mental checklist of the races you have won, or check Progress, and deliberately pick unwon races each session until the twentieth win lands.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: From the official description, beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, and Cal is your fishing rival — find a fishing challenge where Cal is the opponent and out-fish him. The story opens with Gone Fishing, so the fishing mechanics are taught early; practice the casting and reeling timing in casual fishing first, then take on the challenge against Cal when you are comfortable with it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete an arcade game — finish one, any one. Find an arcade in Leonida, pick a cabinet, and play it through to its end rather than quitting halfway. It is a one-and-done trophy and one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so do it during your early activity sampler and bank it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand: work through his missions in order until his final one. Side-character finales are story-adjacent, so they are best done as you meet each character rather than left to a post-story sweep — the strand is there when you are ready, and finishing it banks a Bronze.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the final mission for Kenton. Like Andy's finale, this is the end of a side-character mission strand — play Kenton's missions in order until the last one. The stranger and side-character strands also feed the Silver Strangers & Freaks, which needs 8 strands completed, so every finale you finish counts twice.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is another side-character chain: follow it to its final mission. If you are tracking Strangers & Freaks, Billy's strand is one of the 8 you need, so do not leave side characters half-finished — each completed strand moves two trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are the side quests handed out by the odd characters you meet around the state — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a strand, and their final missions carry their own Bronze trophies. The Silver needs 8 strands, so you must go beyond the named five and find the other stranger chains too. Explore, answer the stranger icons on the map, and finish each strand you start; the Progress screen shows how many strands you have completed.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of the side-character chains that also counts toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks. Work his missions in order as they appear; the final one is the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: From the official description, complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is the last of the named side-character finales — finish his missions in order. With Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone all done, you hold five of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks needs.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE possibly-missable trophy — the only one the launch guides flag. From the official description, meditate at every spot across Leonida; the lists count 18 spots. Output Lag and the other launch guides report that Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this trophy and disappears after that chapter, and PowerPyx and GTABase flag the trophy as the only one that may be missable. The rule is simple: meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and above all do the Chapter 1 balcony spot before Chapter 1 ends. Because there is no mission replay, a missed spot may mean a new playthrough — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and treat this trophy as a Chapter 1 priority, not a cleanup job.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: From the official description, hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is the hunting contact: his strand asks you to track down a specific unique animal, not just any wildlife. Hunting is one of the activity types, so the hunt also feeds Master of None. Follow Bret's missions until the unique-animal hunt appears, then track it patiently — unique animals are one-off encounters, so do not scare it off, and save before the final approach if the game allows it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete 3 collectible card sets. Push Square reports there are 18 card sets in the game, and only 15 of them count toward 100% completion — but this Silver needs just 3 full sets, so it comes much earlier. Pick up cards as you explore, trade or find them in the world, and finish the three sets you are closest to completing first. Cards are a collectible, so a steady habit of grabbing them during story travel beats a dedicated hunt at the end.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, WAiNK It at 100 locations — WAiNK It is the in-game photo/sharing action, done at distinct spots around Leonida. Treat it like a sightseeing checklist: every new area you visit, WAiNK It there. The count is 100, so it rewards exploration rather than repetition — you cannot farm one location. Pair it with The Goodtime State (explore all of Leonida): as you clear the map's dark patches, WAiNK It at each new area and both counters climb together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives scattered across activities — stunts, races, shooting, fishing and more all feed challenge counts. You will clear many of them naturally while chasing the other trophies; check the Progress screen for the challenge list and mop up the easy ones (the ones tied to activities you already do) in cleanup. Fifty sounds like a lot, but it is a volume trophy, not a skill one.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: From the official description, lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. This needs the two protagonists together: build your wanted level up to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and lose the cops. The classic method, from the official description alone, is to cause chaos in a quiet area, then drive into the countryside or hide until the stars clear — do it with your partner present, or it will not count. Do not attempt it during a mission, where a wanted level can fail the objective.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is in the wording: keep the wanted level the whole time — losing the cops between shops breaks the chain, and so does your partner leaving. Plan a route of three close-together shops, rob them quickly one after another with your partner alongside, and keep moving. Do it in free roam, not during a mission, and save first so a failed chain costs you nothing but a retry.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, discover 100 vehicles. Discovery means getting into, or at least encountering, new vehicle models — the count is about variety, not ownership. Drive everything you see: different cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count, and Leonida is full of them. A good habit is to hop into any vehicle model you have not driven before, and to check the Progress screen for the discovery count when you are in a new area.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: From the official description, take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — Combat Focus is the game's slow-mo aiming mode. Find a fight with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. The easiest setup is a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff in the open, where enemies cluster; do not waste it on two or three stragglers. If you fail, the trophy simply does not pop — retry the same kind of fight until five fall in one Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: From the official description, make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: steal a plane at the airport and take off without going through the normal channels. The launch guides note that some free-roam trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch, so treat this one as an experiment: get to VCIA in free roam, find a plane on the tarmac or runway, get in and take off. If it does not pop, try a different aircraft or a different runway — the description's joke is the clue, and the airport is the place.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description alone — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — this trophy is about the Rhino tank. The name is the whole clue: get into a Rhino tank and do what tanks do. The launch guides list this among the free-roam trophies with no confirmed method at launch, so go in expecting to experiment: find a Rhino (military areas and high wanted levels are the classic places tanks appear), get in, and cause enough chaos for the game to register it. If the first attempt does not pop, try surviving in the tank, or taking it on a rampage, until the trigger fires.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob a jewelry store without being detected — stealth is the whole requirement. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out clean. If you are spotted, the attempt fails the condition, so save before you go in and retry until you get a clean run. This is the stealth counterpart to the loud robbery trophies: no alarm, no chase, just in and out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean getaway. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan the approach, hit the vault, and escape the wanted level that follows. The robbery trophies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4, according to the launch guides, so do not expect vaults to be available in the opening hours. Do them one at a time, save between attempts, and count your escapes on the Progress screen.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads: intercept one, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. It is the smallest of the robbery trophies — one truck, one escape — and a good first robbery to learn the pattern before the five bank vaults of Maximum Withdrawal. Do it in free roam with a fast getaway car ready.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, explore all of Leonida — the lists count 52 areas. This is the map-clearing trophy: visit every named area until the map's fog is gone. The launch guides note that flying over the dark patches is the quickest way to clear them, so grab a plane or helicopter for the sweep once the story is done. Pair it with WAiNK It at 100 locations: as each new area clears, WAiNK It there and both trophies move together.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: From the official description, rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — the lists count 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run businesses scattered around Leonida: find one per gang, rob it, and move on to the next gang's turf. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit; the Progress screen should show the count. This is a tour of the criminal map as much as a robbery trophy, so combine it with exploration.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: From the official description, enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or beach spot with a view, and order a cocktail. The launch guides list this among the free-roam trophies with no confirmed method at launch, so if the first drink does not pop it, try a different beachside bar, a different time of day, or sitting with the view in front of you — the description's two conditions are the drink and the view, and Ocean Beach is the place.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: From the official description, smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the classic GTA showroom smash. Drive a car into (or out through) a vehicle showroom's glass front and keep going. The launch guides list this among the trophies with no confirmed method at launch, so expect to experiment: pick a showroom, build speed, and smash through the frontage. If it does not pop, try a different showroom or a heavier vehicle.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: From the official description, follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — go bowling at that specific alley and complete a game (the follow-through is the bowling motion). Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also feeds Master of None. Find the Kolt & Associates alley, play a full game, and the trophy should pop on the follow-through — if it does not, finish the game properly rather than quitting early.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description alone — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — this trophy is about the Jason-and-Lucia partnership reaching a wide audience. The launch guides list it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, so treat the description as the only clue: do something as the pair that gets noticed — the partnership, in public, at scale. Try partner activities in busy Vice City spots and watch for the pop; when the community confirms a method, it will be a public, partnered moment. Until then, do not grind blindly — just play the duo's story and side content together.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, this trophy tracks choices made — and the lists report that PlayStation tracks a count to 500. The trophy guides tie it to the Criminal Profile: GTABase, cited by the lists, describes 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. In practice, that means the small moral and criminal choices you make all over Leonida add up — keep playing, keep choosing, and the counter climbs. It is a volume trophy that rewards a full playthrough rather than any single decision, so do not chase it directly; let it arrive while you clean up the rest.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description alone — 'Second time's the charm' — this trophy pops on a second attempt at something. The launch guides list it among the trophies with no confirmed method at launch, so the honest reading is: fail something once, then succeed on the retry. It may be tied to a specific activity or challenge where the second try counts, or to a story moment you redo — keep it in mind whenever you fail and retry an activity, and note which retry pops it. Do not force it; it is likely to arrive on its own during a long Platinum run.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description alone — 'What the hell just happened?' — this trophy is a surprise moment somewhere in Leonida. The launch guides list it among the trophies with no confirmed method at launch, and the wording points to a random event, an Easter egg, or a strange encounter in the open world. Explore widely, pay attention to odd sights and random events, and it will likely pop when you stumble into the right one. It is the kind of trophy that rewards curiosity rather than grinding — keep your eyes open during the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From the official description, bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — a drive-by attack using a melee weapon, not a gun. Get in a vehicle as the passenger (or driver, if the game allows a melee swing), equip a melee weapon, and knock someone down while the car is moving. The bowling pun is the clue: the victim should be bowled over by the passing car. Find a quiet road with pedestrians, line the pass up slowly, and swing as you pass — it may take a few tries to connect.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: From the official description, earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money you pick up from robberies and heists; your contacts launder them into clean cash. The total is cumulative — $250,000 across the whole run — so every robbery feeds it: bank vaults, armored trucks and illegal operations all produce bills to launder. Keep laundering after every score rather than hoarding bills, and watch the total climb toward a quarter of a million.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative spending in every shop in Leonida counts. Weapons, clothes, food, vehicle mods: it all adds up. You will spend a large part of this naturally on guns and gear for the story and the Shooting Range; in cleanup, top it off with vehicle mods or clothes rather than wasting cash. It pairs with Treat Yo Self's sibling Dime on the Dollar — earn dirty money, launder it, then spend it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: From the official description, purchase all garage properties — the lists count 8 garages. Garages are properties you buy to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good and register for On the Spot, so this trophy ties the collection together: buy all 8, fill them with cars you find, and the trophy pops with the last purchase. Save up for them during the story — they are an investment that pays off across three trophies at once.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: From the official description, register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle app: take vehicles you discover (which also feeds Whip It Good) and register ten of them through the app. Any ten vehicles will do, so register the first ten you drive — do it early, while you are discovering vehicles anyway, and this Bronze banks itself.
